thread:
oliver: FYI: noticed uneven GPU packing in ap-southeast1 at 09:06 UTC. small pods concentrating on two racks, others idle. latency up for low-priority jobs.
sana: any recent label/taint changes?
matt: we rolled out `egress=constrained:NoSchedule` via the egress rollout job ~08:50 but the selector accidentally targeted `zone: ap-southeast1-a` instead of the intended node pool. so entire AZ slice got tainted.
yuan: that would explain the squeeze. scheduler sees many nodes as NoSchedule so pending pods pile on remaining nodes -> binpacking fragmentation -> preemptions.
oliver: logs from scheduler show a bunch of FailedScheduling: `45/120 nodes had taint egress=constrained:NoSchedule`.
sana: can we narrow the taint quickly? options: 1) remove taint from healthy nodes (fast), 2) patch rollout job and reapply (safer), 3) scale temporary capacity (warmpool) while we fix (costly).
matt: I'd do 1 + 2. Remove taint from two racks to rebalance, then patch selector and re-run the rollout in canary mode.
devops-bot: AUTOSCALER: added 24 nodes at 09:11 due to PodPending increase.
yuan: note: autoscaler triggered because many pods specify fractional GPU (0.25) and our merging logic packs them. with fewer eligible nodes packing density increased leading to NVLink rack saturation and evictions.
sana: matt, can you run `kubectl taint nodes node-apse1-02 node-apse1-03 egress=constrained:NoSchedule-` for two nodes and watch for rescheduling? also add quick health checks to ensure we're not untainting actually constrained nodes.
matt: will do. running now.
(matt runs commands)
matt: removed taint on node-apse1-02 and node-apse1-03. watching pod spread.
yuan: eviction rate dropping, new pods landing across 6 racks now. good sign.
oliver: can we rollback the extra nodes the autoscaler spun up? want to avoid cost spike.
devops-bot: AUTOSCALER: scaleDown candidates available, will downscale idle nodes after 10m of inactivity.
sana: matt, please make the rollout selector change and add unit test to prevent zone-level matches. create PR and tag me.
matt: PR opened: #eng-platform/rollout-fix. patch updates the selector to `kubernetes.io/instance-group` and adds a regression test.
yuan: cost rough: extra 24 x g4dn-ish ~ $3.8/hr while up. if we can reclaim in 15m we're fine. if not, escalate to finance.
oliver: action items: matt remove taints (done), sana review PR, yuan monitor autoscaler and eviction metrics, matt follow up with postmortem blameless draft. check back in 30m. :thumbsup:
sana: adding follow-up: consider scheduler improvement to prefer spreading fractional-GPU pods across eligible racks when label skew exists. file an RFC?
matt: filing RFC: `fractional-pod-spread-scheduler` and cc eng-platform.
